this_title: We'll Find You When the Sun Goes Black
trans_title: PRONAĆI ĆEMO TE KAD SUNCE POSTANE CRNO
introduction: We’ll find you when the sun goes black is a mesmerizing film transporting you to a new dimension, where the infinitely small and the infinitely large can become one. Supported by a solemn song composed by Vessel (Sebastian Gainsborough), the work embalms body and mind. (源自: Courtisane Festival 2024)
